jobs.label: Feature gate
jobs.what: Asks if a feature is on or if the user has a permission (GetHas*, *_PermissionCheck).

jobs.label: Image
jobs.what: Shows entity images with UBT_LazyImage, gets signed URLs and entity-type icons.

jobs.label: Device cache
jobs.what: Keeps countries, localities, subdivisions, policies and the user on the device.

jobs.label: Subscription gate
jobs.what: Shows the upgrade pop-up or the access-restricted dialog when the user has no access.

jobs.label: App shell
jobs.what: Gives the bottom bar, the menu and the search categories.

jobs.label: Share
jobs.what: Opens the share sheet and shares an entity by link.

jobs.label: CTA pop-ups
jobs.what: Shows address, contact-by-phone, contact-by-message and share pop-ups.

jobs.label: Local bookmarks
jobs.what: Stores bookmarks on the device and keeps the bookmark cache in sync.

jobs.label: Notification inbox
jobs.what: Gives the unread count and renders the legacy message list and detail.

jobs.label: Legacy screen blocks
jobs.origin: Share_UI, Email, Utils_Message, Audit, ApplicationEvents_Directory, ApplicationEvents_LDM
jobs.what: Renders legacy share and e-mail screens, shows a message after navigation, logs an application event.

jobs.label: Legacy helpers
jobs.what: Time-zone offset, image load error handler, logo image, business type list.
